# Papercuts — pixelkit

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-11-03 [claude] The README said the gallery example writes target/gallery.png; it actually writes target/gallery@1x.png (and @2x.png with a scale argument), so a copy step failed. Corrected the README and CONTRIBUTING.  `@pixelkit.papercut.the-readme-said-the-gallery-example-writes/1`
- 2026-11-03 [claude] Building docs with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings fails in liminalkit-raster before any other crate is documented: png/decode.rs links a private MAX_DIMENSION and png/mod.rs links `write`, which is both a function and a macro. Scope the check to the crates being changed or fix those two links.  `@pixelkit.papercut.building-docs-with-rustdocflags-d-warnings/1`
- 2026-10-15 [codex] The new touch example initially passed run_app arguments in config/app order; the API takes app/config. Compilation caught this and the example was corrected. Theme is defined outside a standalone theme.rs, so filename guessing also missed.  `@pixelkit.papercut.the-new-touch-example-initially-passed-run-app/1`
- 2026-10-15 [codex] The knowledge MCP tools named by AGENTS.md are unavailable in this session; used the equivalent akr CLI. The winit docs.rs page also failed to load, so API details were checked in the installed crate source.  `@pixelkit.papercut.the-knowledge-mcp-tools-named-by-agents-md-are/1`
- 2026-10-15 [codex] The experimental tuning example initially used Rect::new in a const, but that constructor is not const; cargo check caught it. Replaced it with a Rect literal without changing the raster API.  `@pixelkit.papercut.the-experimental-tuning-example-initially-used/1`

## Not about this project

Frictions with something else — a tool, a harness — hit while working here. They are logged where they were hit; `akr papercut collate --about <subject>` is how the project that owns the subject gathers them.

- 2026-11-06 [claude] (git) On Windows with core.autocrlf=true, .akr/akr.lock and records/pixelkit/work.akr checked out CRLF; akr reads LF only, so check reported 210 AKR-P003 errors and build could not seal new records. Fixed with .gitattributes eol=lf for /.akr/** and /docs/generated/**.  `@pixelkit.papercut.on-windows-with-core-autocrlf-true-akr-akr-lock/1`

Left the papercut open.  `@pixelkit.papercut.closing-a-papercut-through-knowledge-revise/1`
